name: OmniHand O10
summary: OmniHand O10 is AgiBot's compact five-finger hand for humanoid manipulation and gesture interaction. Its linkage-driven design provides 10 active and 16 total degrees of freedom, with motors and gearing integrated into a hand measuring 180 mm long. The manufacturer lists CAN FD and RS485 communication, several position and force control modes, and support for secondary development. description.en: OmniHand O10 is AgiBot's compact five-finger hand for humanoid manipulation and gesture interaction. Its linkage-driven design provides 10 active and 16 total degrees of freedom, with motors and gearing integrated into a hand measuring 180 mm long. The manufacturer lists CAN FD and RS485 communication, several position and force control modes, and support for secondary development. Standard and tactile configurations differ: the tactile version adds 268 sensing points and carries a higher weight specification. The published specifications should therefore be matched to the selected configuration.
description.zh: 智元灵动款灵巧手，具有10个主动自由度及16个总自由度，采用连杆结构，区分触觉与非触觉配置。

specs.label: Active degrees of freedom
specs.conditions: Configuration: OmniHand 2025 O10 (SDK README specification); Source version: Official AgiBotTech SDK README captured 2026-10-16

sources.title: agibot-sdk
sources.quote: 紧凑型高自由度交互灵巧手，具有 `10 个主动 + 6 个被动自由度`。重量仅 500g，采用 CANFD 通信接口，配备 `400+ 触觉点，0.1N 阵列分辨率，最大指尖力 5N`。适用于各种人形机器人和机械臂。其紧凑轻量化的设计和丰富的触觉交互能力，使其在交互服务、研究教育、轻量作业等领域具有重要价值。
